basic_details.scholarship_name: Tokyo Tech IGP MEXT University Recommendation Fellowship
basic_details.offering_entity: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT, Japan) administered by Institute of Science Tokyo (formerly Tokyo Institute of Technology)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Institute of Science Tokyo (Ookayama & Suzukakedai Campuses, Tokyo & Yokohama, Japan)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Restricted to the International Graduate Program (IGP-A and IGP-C) across Schools of Science, Engineering, Materials and Chemical Technology, Computing (Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence), Life Science and Technology, and Environment and Society.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: Approximately 45 to 60 University Recommendation MEXT slots allocated annually across all graduate schools
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Merit-based open international quota; Pakistani engineering and computer science students typically secure 4 to 8 awards annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years for Master degree; 3 years for PhD degree; extension from Master to PhD possible subject to nationwide MEXT screening

nationality_requirements: Citizens of countries having diplomatic relations with Japan (including Pakistan)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Must be born on or after April 2, 1992 for the 2027 intake (under 35 years of age on departure).
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 16 years of formal education (Bachelor degree) for Master applicants; 18 years (Master degree) for Doctoral applicants from an HEC-recognized university with high academic standing (minimum 3.40 / 4.00 CGPA; 3.60+ highly competitive). Must hold a minimum 2.30 / 3.00 on the MEXT GPA evaluation formula.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: MEXT grade point calculation formula: Grade points derived as [ (credits with score 80-100 x 3) + (credits with score 70-79 x 2) + (credits with score 60-69 x 1) ] / Total credits. Must equal or exceed 2.30 / 3.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Strong undergraduate or postgraduate foundation in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Physics, or Applied Mathematics.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Final-year graduating students eligible provided degree completion and official transcripts are conferred prior to September 2027 enrollment.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: No fixed graduation year cutoff, provided age requirement is respected.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory. Outstanding academic thesis, capstone engineering projects, or indexed research publications (IEEE, ACM, Springer) significantly enhance candidate standing.

english_proficiency.notes: Official TOEFL iBT (minimum 80, 90+ recommended) or IELTS Academic (minimum 6.5, 7.0 recommended). Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates accepted only if applicant graduated from an institution in an English-native country.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Japanese language ability is NOT required for admission or funding; all coursework and research supervision conducted in English. Free Japanese language immersion courses offered upon arrival.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: None; female researchers in engineering and computer science are strongly encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: STEM researchers in engineering, artificial intelligence, robotics, and physical sciences.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be a concurrent recipient of any other Japanese government scholarship or foreign government grant.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full exemption from Tokyo Tech annual tuition fee (JPY 635,400 / year waived completely for all standard degree years).

admission_application_fee.details: 100% full waiver of Tokyo Tech examination fee (JPY 30,000) and enrollment fee (JPY 282,000 waived completely).

accommodation.details: First-year international students guaranteed subsidized housing in Tokyo Tech International Student Dormitories (costing ~JPY 35,000 to JPY 55,000/month), paid directly from monthly stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living allowance paid directly to scholar's Japan Post Bank account: JPY 147,000/month for Master's students; JPY 148,000/month for PhD students (~PKR 270,000 to 275,000/month).

airfare.details: Pre-paid round-trip single economy class air ticket between Islamabad/Karachi/Lahore and Tokyo Narita/Haneda airport provided by MEXT at arrival and departure.

visa_fee.details: Official MEXT scholarship certificate provides fee-exempt Student Visa processing at Embassy of Japan in Islamabad or Consulate-General in Karachi.

health_insurance.details: Japanese National Health Insurance (NHI) monthly premium (~JPY 1,500 to JPY 2,500/month) is paid from stipend, granting 70% medical coverage across all Japanese hospitals, with Tokyo Tech Mutual Aid Association reimbursing remainder.

food_allowance.details: Living expenses covered by monthly stipend; campus cafeterias provide affordable meals at JPY 400 - JPY 700 per meal.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Funded by the admitting research laboratory and departmental research operational budgets.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Kakenhi research assistantship (RA) top-ups and lab travel funds available for attending international conferences and field research.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to JPY 250,000 per conference paper

travel_transit_allowance.details: Tokyo commuter rail and subway passes are self-funded from the monthly stipend (student commuter discounts available).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single elite national institution: Institute of Science Tokyo (formerly Tokyo Institute of Technology)
participating_institutions: Institute of Science Tokyo (Ookayama Campus, Meguro, Tokyo)
Institute of Science Tokyo (Suzukakedai Campus, Midori-ku, Yokohama)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 100 global university (QS World #84, #1 in Japan for Engineering & Technology). Formed by historic October 2024 merger of Tokyo Tech and Tokyo Medical and Dental University (TMDU).
available_majors: School of Computing: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematical and Computing Science
School of Engineering: Mechanical Engineering, Systems and Control, Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Information and Communications Engineering
School of Materials and Chemical Technology: Materials Science and Engineering, Applied Chemistry
School of Life Science and Technology: Life Science and Technology
School of Environment and Society: Transdisciplinary Science and Engineering, Civil and Environmental Engineering
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master degree: 2 years (4 semesters); PhD degree: 3 years (6 semesters); Integrated PhD: 5 years.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's (MS track) or Master's (PhD track) in STEM with 3.4+ GPA, prospective professor preliminary consent, research proposal, 2 recommendation letters, and IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 80.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: School of Computing (AI, machine learning, robotics) is exceptionally competitive; Materials Science, Applied Chemistry, and Civil Engineering offer comparatively higher selection probability for strong experimentalists.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Prospective applicants MUST browse Tokyo Tech STAR Search faculty database, identify a professor whose current research grants match their thesis, and obtain official written consent before submitting application. Unmatched applications are disqualified immediately.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Institute of Science Tokyo International Graduate Program (IGP) Online Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Contact prospective professor via email between August and October; upon securing supervisory consent, register an account on the Tokyo Tech IGP online portal and complete the application.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (August - October): Explore Tokyo Tech laboratories via STAR Search portal; prepare research proposal tailored to faculty publications.
Step 2 (September - Mid-November): Contact prospective professor, submit academic dossier, conduct online interview, and obtain written consent of supervision.
Step 3 (November - December): Create account on Tokyo Tech Online Application System; upload transcripts, English test report, and statement of research.
Step 4 (January): Departmental faculty screening committee evaluates applicants and ranks candidates for MEXT quota.
Step 5 (February - March): Tokyo Tech internal university recommendation board nominates top candidates to MEXT Headquarters in Tokyo.
Step 6 (June - July): Official MEXT approval announced; university issues Certificate of Eligibility (CoE) and formal letter of scholarship.
Step 7 (July - August): Apply for Japanese Student Visa at Embassy of Japan in Pakistan; flight e-tickets issued by MEXT travel agent.
Step 8 (Late September): Arrival in Tokyo; campus dorm check-in and university matriculation.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Direct integrated nomination: Science Tokyo nominates admitted IGP-A candidates directly to MEXT for the full government scholarship.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two recommendation letters submitted online via referee email invitation link generated by Tokyo Tech admissions portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Field of Study and Research Plan: Detail past academic background, proposed research methodology, expected contributions, and laboratory facility usage.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Rigorous 3 to 5 page proposal detailing background, methodology, objectives, and laboratory equipment utilization in close consultation with supervisor.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing research publications, conference presentations, major engineering capstone projects, and GitHub/code repositories.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: One to two rounds of rigorous technical video interviews (Zoom) conducted by prospective supervisor and departmental doctoral committee evaluating research feasibility and fundamentals.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT (minimum 80, 90+ recommended) or IELTS Academic (minimum 6.5, 7.0 recommended). GRE General recommended for computing.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: JPY 0 (Exempt for MEXT University Recommendation track applicants)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Official degree certificate and transcripts attested by Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation for any non-English educational or civil records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Complete digital submission on Tokyo Tech IGP online portal followed by dispatch of hard-copy attested dossier if requested by department.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Completed and digitally signed via Tokyo Tech Online Portal.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure names and date of birth match Pakistani Passport and CNIC exactly.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official written consent or email confirmation from Tokyo Tech Professor/Associate Professor.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be secured prior to formal online submission; without this, application is automatically void.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Certified official transcripts and degree certificates with grading scale and credit breakdown.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be verified and attested by Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Field of Study and Research Plan
required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed 3 to 5 page proposal detailing background, methodology, objectives, and laboratory equipment utilization.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Should cite Tokyo Tech laboratory papers and demonstrate independent scholarly competence.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential recommendation letters from Dean, department chair, or academic thesis advisor.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be on official institutional letterhead with institutional email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official ETS TOEFL iBT or British Council/IDP IELTS Academic test scorecard.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Institutional code for Tokyo Tech used for direct score delivery where requested.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Summary of Master Thesis / Undergraduate Project
required_documents_checklist.specification: 1 to 2 page technical synopsis of completed capstone project or Master research.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight practical contributions, algorithms designed, and research publications.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Bio-data page copy valid for at least 18 months from expected arrival date.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure Pakistani machine-readable passport bio page is clear and completely legible.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: IGP(A) is dedicated to overseas applicants seeking MEXT university recommendation scholarships commencing in Autumn (late September).

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 30% (Standardized MEXT 3-point GPA formula evaluation, undergraduate CGPA, and coursework rigor)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 5% (Student leadership, campus engagement, and community work)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Quality, feasibility, and synergy of research proposal with host laboratory projects)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Relevant industry research or software engineering experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 5% (Motivation, intellectual clarity, and long-term academic vision)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Rigor and conviction of academic referee appraisals)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 15% (Performance in technical interview and oral defense with laboratory faculty)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Admitting Laboratory Head, Departmental Graduate Committee, and Tokyo Tech International Student Admissions Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-tier faculty selection: Initial lab-level review and interview by prospective supervisor followed by departmental graduate committee evaluation and Institute of Science Tokyo MEXT Recommendation Committee ranking. Approximately 1:8 applicants nominated from department to university board; 95%+ of university-nominated candidates approved by MEXT.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~600 to 800 international applicants across all disciplines for IGP-A track
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~45 to 60 MEXT University Recommendation awards annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~11.0% (Strong placement for Pakistani engineers with IEEE/ACM papers)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Top 10% class rank, strong programming/lab fundamentals, 1+ Scopus/IEEE published papers, clear research plan matching supervisor's lab.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: BS/MS graduates in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Materials Science from NUST, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, UET, and PIEAS.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: China, Indonesia, Vietnam, Pakistan, Thailand, India

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized consultancies charging placement fees for Tokyo Tech scholarships. Science Tokyo charges ZERO application fee for IGP-A MEXT track and never uses private agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Tokyo Tech application for IGP-A MEXT recommendation track is 100% free of charge. Never pay examination fees to intermediaries.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Communicating directly with prospective professors demonstrates research maturity; using agents will lead to immediate rejection.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Initial 3 to 4 weeks living expenses and apartment/dorm security deposit before first stipend disbursement (prepare ~JPY 100,000 to JPY 150,000 in cash; ~PKR 185,000 to 275,000).
Domestic travel expenses within Pakistan to reach Islamabad/Karachi departure airport.
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: Japanese language proficiency is mandatory. (FACT: 100% of coursework, research, and thesis defense in IGP are conducted in English).
CLAIM: GRE General score is compulsory. (FACT: GRE is optional for most departments, only required by specific labs as designated in IGP guides).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some education agencies state applicants can apply directly without contacting a professor; official Tokyo Tech regulations state preliminary professor consent is mandatory before submitting application.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain MEXT 3-point GPA of at least 2.30 throughout degree tenure and pass annual doctoral milestone defenses.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory daily laboratory attendance, participation in weekly research seminars (Zemi), and active laboratory duty.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual progress reports reviewed by academic mentor and submitted to MEXT.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: MEXT recipients are prohibited from taking outside part-time jobs (arubaito) except approved internal Teaching Assistant (TA) or Research Assistant (RA) positions within Tokyo Tech.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. Scholars are free to pursue post-doctoral employment, industrial careers in Japan (qualifying for Japan Highly Skilled Foreign Professional visa), or international opportunities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is suspended or cancelled if student fails to maintain satisfactory academic standing, takes unauthorized leaves of absence, or violates Japanese laws; past disbursements are not reclaimed.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Strictly prohibited. MEXT university recommendation slots are tied exclusively to Tokyo Tech.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing laboratory or major is generally not permitted unless approved under extraordinary academic circumstances by the faculty board.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Master graduates may compete for MEXT extension to enter PhD program through internal university selection based on research accomplishments.
